lines.japanese: ──よし、じゃあお言葉に甘えてご馳走になるか。なんだかんだ言っても美味いしな、ここのクレープ。
lines.english: —Okay, then. Guess I'd take her up on it and let her treat me. Whatever else, the crêpes here were good.

lines.japanese: などというわずかな思考の間隙に、むんずと腕を掴まれた。鳴だ。
lines.english: Before the thought had even cleared my head, a hand clamped around my arm. Naru.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「食べていきましょう」
lines.english: “Let's stay and eat.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「私もおかわりをいただきます。ドラさんもおひとつ食していきましょう。そして皆で仲良くクレープ談議に華を咲かせましょう」
lines.english: “I will have another helping. You should partake of one as well, Dra. Then we can all enjoy a friendly and animated discussion of crêpes.”

lines.japanese: 「おッ、いいよ鳴。その掴み方はいいよ、素質あるよ」
lines.english: “Ooh, that's good, Naru. That's how you grab him. You've got talent.”

lines.japanese: なんの素質だよ。なんでもいいけど。
lines.english: Talent for what? Never mind.

lines.japanese: 「つか、クレープ談議ってなに」
lines.english: “What the hell is a discussion of crêpes?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、そうですねー、たとえば、このお店ではどのクレープが美味しいかを激しく論じどれも美味しいに決まってるじゃないですか」
lines.english: “Well, let's see. For example, we might fiercely debate which crêpe here is best—though obviously every last one is delicious.”

lines.japanese: 質問したら、回答と叱責がセットになって返ってきた。
lines.english: I asked one question and got an answer-and-scolding combo in return.

lines.japanese: なんでだよ。思わず俺は右手を鳴の頭上に振りあげ──
lines.english: Why? Without thinking, I raised my right hand over Naru's head—
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: ──ぺちっ。四本の指をやつの前髪の隙間に置いた。
lines.english: —tap. Four fingers slipped through the gap in her bangs and landed on her forehead.

lines.japanese: 「たはー」
lines.english: “Ta-ha!”

lines.japanese: 「あァ……そっかコレだ……」
lines.english: “Ah... Right. This is it...”

lines.japanese: 俺は軽めのスナップで二度三度と空を叩く。そうかコレだ……コレだわ。
lines.english: I snapped my wrist lightly through the empty air two or three times. That was it... Yes. That was it.

lines.japanese: なんか、コツを取りもどした気がする。俺は軽く咳払いをして喉のつかえを取っぱらった。
lines.english: Felt like I'd gotten the hang of it again. I cleared my throat and shook loose whatever had been stuck there.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、どーすんだよおまえ。あァ、それじゃクレープ談議できねーじゃん」
lines.english: “Well, now what? You can't have your crêpe discussion like that.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いえいえ、まだまだバリエーションありますよー。えー、美味しいクレープの作り方ですとかー」
lines.english: “Oh, no, no, we've still got lots more variations. Um, like, how to make a tasty crêpe, or...”

lines.japanese: 「え、どうすんの。美味しいクレープどうやって作んの」
lines.english: “Oh? How do you do it? How do you make a delicious crêpe?”

lines.japanese: 「え……えーとですね、えー、まずその、ボボ、ボールに玉子を……掻きまぜますよ？」
lines.english: “Well... um... First you put an egg in a b-b-bowl and... whisk it?”

lines.japanese: ちら、と鳴が首を傾けてミニバンの中を覗きこむ。店主は感心したように頷いた。
lines.english: Naru tilted her head and stole a glance inside the minivan. The owner nodded, impressed.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ほら！　ほら掻きまぜるんですよ。それはもう、親の仇のように勢いよく掻きまぜるんですよ」
lines.english: “See? See! You whisk it. Whisk it furiously, like it murdered your parents.”

lines.japanese: 「やァ、だめだめ。やり過ぎたら気泡できちまうよ、そこァ軽くでいいんだ」
lines.english: “Hey, no, no. Keep that up and you'll work bubbles into it. Just go light there.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんですよ、軽くでいいんですよ」
lines.english: “Exactly. A light touch is enough.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんですよじゃねーだろ。てめ、おもくそ間違ってたじゃねーか」
lines.english: “Don't ‘that's right’ me. You were completely fucking wrong!”

lines.japanese: ぺちっ。
lines.english: Tap.

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴の額に、さっきよりすんなりと指の腹を当てた。
lines.english: This time, the pads of my fingers found Naru's forehead more naturally than before.

lines.japanese: 「とへへ」
lines.english: “Tee-huh.”

lines.japanese: やつは奇怪なつぶやきを漏らしながら、靴の踵で地面を蹴る。
lines.english: She let out the peculiar sound and scuffed the ground with the heel of her shoe.

lines.japanese: 「ニヤニヤすんな。口閉じろ口」
lines.english: “Quit grinning. Close your mouth. Your mouth.”

lines.japanese: それから俺たちはパルさん自慢のクレープを食いながら、「首の皮一枚つながる」でお馴染みの首の皮とクレープの皮ってどっちが薄いの？とかの高尚なクレープ談議に華を咲かせた。
lines.english: Then, over Paru's celebrated crêpes, we launched into lofty crêpe debate: which was thinner, a crêpe or the last shred of skin keeping a man's neck attached?
